3.name: R
3.text: Would this be a poorly disguised brothel or something of the sort?

6.name: R
6.text: With that hole in the ceiling and the cliched getup you’re wearing, I figured this was a mere facade.

8.name: R
8.text: What is it that you are doing here, exactly?

11.name: R
11.text: Why are you wasting your time in this place?

12.name: R
12.text: Don’t you have any other prospects in your life?

13.name: R
13.text: Would you say that you are at your lowest right now?

16.name: R
16.text: Well, no matter that. I think you are, very much.

17.name: R
17.text: You can’t change anything, can’t control anything.

18.name: R
18.text: Your life is at the hands of others entirely.

20.name: R
20.text: That feeling of helplessness, of living on while surrendering yourself without any consent… So delightful!

21.name: R
21.text: What a poor lamb you are, oh so poor.

22.name: R
22.text: I delight myself in that very much.

23.name: M
23.text: …Can I help you with anything in the store?

27.name: R
27.text: Of course, not any ordinary coffee…

28.name: R
28.text: Something to quench the thirst, something to keep me awake all night and then some, and leave me time to think and imagine vividly.

29.name: R
29.text: You can do that for me, can’t you? Maybe an Affogato?.
